text:
mia: FYI I opened a PR to consolidate guidance for anchors and parsing heuristics for function/tool calling structured outputs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 :eyes:

alex: Thanks — skimmed the diff. overall clean. main question: do we want the example JSON schema to show required fields or keep everything nullable for backward compat?

sam (sdk): Prefer required for the canonical example, but add a note and a nullable shim example for v1 -> v2 migrations. we should also update the JS SDK snippet to show `parseResponse` fallback.

tara (legal): Heads up — the quick example that includes a PII placeholder needs to be sanitized. recommend replacing with a generic `id` string.

mia: Good call, tara. I've swapped the example to use `id: "item_123"`. Also added a tiny migration callout block.

alex: Can we add this JSON snippet under the "canonical schema" section?

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": { "type": "string" },
    "args": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": true },
    "id": { "type": "string" }
  },
  "required": ["action", "id"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

mia: yes — that's what I pushed to the branch. I also added a short guardrail note: "If unparseable, return a best-effort JSON object and annotate with `parsing_confidence`."

ryan (pm): Can we be explicit about routing and fallbacks? e.g., a sample policy: prefer `model-v2` -> fallback to `model-v1-compat` with `kv_cache` off. A one-sentence callout is enough.

sam (sdk): I'll add an SDK snippet showing the fallback config. Proposed JS snippet:

```js
// high-level example
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'model-v2',
  fallback: ['model-v1-compat'],
  parse: true,
});
const data = parseResponse(resp) || { action: 'noop', parsing_confidence: 0 };
```

mia: perfect. can you open a tiny PR to the sdk-examples repo and link it here?

sam (sdk): on it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/pull/314 — includes tests for `parseResponse` fallback.

alex: quick editorial nit: change "parsing_confidence" to camelCase `parsingConfidence` in the prose, since our examples are JS-first. We can still present the schema in snake_case as a language-agnostic example but show camelCase in SDK snippet.

mia: done — updated prose and added a short note: "Schema example (language-agnostic) vs SDK usage (camelCase)."

tara (legal): Approved on content after id sanitization.

docs-bot: preview deployed — https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/8421/index.html

mia: Great — can we get two reviewers from eng and one from SDK? @alex @sam

alex: I'll review and merge if CI passes.

sam (sdk): Reviewing now. small change: add test for `parsingConfidence` mapping in the SDK shim.

mia: CI green except a lint flake in the examples table (link anchor mismatch). I fixed locally and pushed.

deploy-bot: docs-preview updated: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/8421/index.html#anchors-and-parse-guidance

alex: LGTM. merging in 5 if no objections.

ryan (pm): Quick follow-up ticket: add an automated check that examples with `parse: true` surface a `parsing_confidence` example in docs. filing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/product/issues/1209

mia: thanks all. after merge I'll open a short migration note for customer-facing changelog and ping support.

sam (sdk): Thanks — I'll wire the SDK doc link into the v2 migration guide once merged.

mia: closing loop: merged and live. thanks everyone :tada:
